3518-3605-5131-6472.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Deceptive Frostike by paying {U}{U}, causing it to enter with flying as a Dragon copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2279-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2999-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2999-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

6461-6495--5.easyPrerequisites: Warden of the Grove has a counter on it.
6461-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
6461-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5411-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

2034-4871-6556-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5359-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4149-4599-4871-6019-7175.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6259-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6259-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-997-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1309-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-3215-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

622-1308-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-1308-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

141-2438-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

2034-4336-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4289-5051-5078-6918.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

710-1703-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

338-3197-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-6097.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1171-4927.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-4927.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

1445-2279-2292-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-2292-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

465-643-3742-4251-4885.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1603-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Evil Twin on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1603-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Evil Twin to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1621-2072-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
1621-2072-4605.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

4863-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
4863-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Revolutionist and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Revolutionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

3129-3996-4050.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

575-2034-4180.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-2034-4180.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Lands.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky

2438-2650-2781.description:
Cast Invasion of Tolvada by paying {3}{W}{B}.
When Invasion of Tolvada enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Invasion of Tolvada.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Invasion of Tolvada.
Repeat from step 2.

876-2068-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
876-2068-4283.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Whisper.
Activate Whisper by tapping and sacrificing it and another nontoken creature you control, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Whisper.
Resolve both Whisper abilities, returning Whisper and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

132-2645-4045.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

813-1846-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Islands.
813-1846-1987.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}, creating a delayed triggered ability that adds {U} whenever an Island is tapped for mana this turn.
Activate four Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
High Tide's delayed trigger triggers four times, adding an additional {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}, creating a second delayed triggered ability.
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
High Tide delayed triggers trigger a combined total of four times, adding an additional {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking an Island and Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning High Tide and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7, except that you activate only one Island in step 8 and trigger an increasing number of High Tide delayed triggered abilities in step 9.
